scripts.dev: npx concurrently -n "server,client" -c "blue,cyan" "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.docs:build: npm run docs:legal && npm run docs:sales:playbook && npm run docs:sales:leavebehind
scripts.build: npm install --prefix client && npm run build --prefix client && npm install --prefix server && npm run db:generate --prefix server && npm run build --prefix server
scripts.start: cd server && npx prisma db push --accept-data-loss --schema prisma/schema.prisma && npx tsx prisma/seed.ts && node dist/index.js
